_doc: Build classes and each fighter's declared build, for `npm run lineup` (art/CHARACTER_SCALE.md, Build classes). Optional headColors / feetColors (hex) override the scale gate's automatic head and shoe palettes (Scale gate (automatic)). sbr = shoulder band / standingPx, by the idle's hand style (guard = hands up in front of the chest; down = hands down or in the pockets); dr = deltoid-to-deltoid width by eye / standingPx (the gate measure, recorded in deltoidPx); mwrMin = the idle's max width / its height with hair. Fighters are listed in roster order.

naruto._headColors: the hair yellow only: the automatic palette also took the headband cloth, plate and orange shades the jacket shares, which welded the head to the collar or to raised sleeves

sasuke._headColors: his hair is drawn in outline and coat shades, so the automatic head palette (art/CHARACTER_SCALE.md Scale gate) misses most of it

gojo._note: Approved neutral height v01 overrides old 215px and deltoid78 target. Lean long-limbed build; class thresholds remain historical diagnostics pending Claude spec migration.
